failedAssertions.reason: Pre-existing contract/code mismatch: validation contract specifies global Plus Code format '849VCWC8+R9' (8-char prefix) should be accepted, but validatePlusCode() regex /^[A-Z0-9]{2,4}\+[A-Z0-9]{2,3}$/i only supports short format (2-4 chars before '+'). The showError/hideError fix (errorToInputMap) works correctly — errors show/hide on the correct input element. Original inline code at commit 0134aac had an unused fullPlusCodeRegex variable but never used it in the validation logic. Not a refactor regression. The fix feature (fix-show-error-input-id-mapping) resolved the original bug (input ID mapping); VAL-FORM-007's remaining failure is a separate pre-existing issue with the Plus Code regex not supporting global format.

notes: Round 2 re-tested the 4 assertions that failed in round 1, after the fix-show-error-input-id-mapping feature was completed. VAL-FORM-004 (phone), VAL-FORM-005 (email), and VAL-FORM-006 (hours) now PASS — the errorToInputMap correctly maps error elements to input elements, and showError/hideError work as expected. VAL-FORM-007 (plus code) still FAILS, but for a different reason than round 1: the showError/hideError mapping now works correctly (errors show/hide on #storePlusCode), but the validatePlusCode() regex only accepts short-format Plus Codes (2-4 chars before '+'), while the contract test uses global format '849VCWC8+R9' (8 chars before '+'). This is a pre-existing contract/code mismatch — the original code at commit 0134aac had an unused fullPlusCodeRegex variable but never applied it. The 32/33 pass rate confirms the start-app-extraction refactor is behavior-preserving, and the showError/hideError fix successfully resolved 3 of the 4 pre-existing bugs surfaced by validation.
